name: transition-linear-wipe
title: Linear Wipe
description: Một mép thẳng quét ngang lộ cảnh mới, cảnh cũ đứng yên, có thể kèm một vạch màu thương hiệu chạy theo mép.

moworks.author: takayu

options.direction: the way the edge travels: right (default), left, up, down
options.bar: px of the brand bar riding the edge (4; 0 for none; ×3 here)

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tr-wipe, written here): Incoming scene revealed by a straight clip edge, clip width 0 -> 100 % over 500 ms easeInOutCubic; the outgoing scene does not move; optional 4 px brand-colour bar riding the edge. Directions left / right / up / down. Params: duration (0.5 s) · direction (trái / phải / lên / xuống) · bar: vạch mép (4 px).
